What stops 1,000 fakes? Sponsors. A newcomer needs a sponsor locking 200 for 15 epochs and 100 of its own. No sponsor, no entry.
Caught fakes? Both pay. The newcomer loses all 100; the sponsor loses 50% and rights for 10 epochs. A hollow promise costs real money. The referral vine is public; stars get flagged.
What does an attack cost? 1,000 fakes need 500 sponsors, 100,000 units. At 30% detection the joint loss is 45,000. At dawn, sponsors pay.
